summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SUPER GIRL Fase 1 Demo. 27/27 backend pytest cases pass on public preview URL, covering auth (admin/operator/wrong password/me), seed (13 leads, 8 pipeline stages, services/locations/campaigns/team/KB), conversations list/filters/detail, AI qualify (no handoff), AI handoff core flow (verifies handoff=true, motivo=prenotazione, new_status=da_fissare, structured summary, lead moved to da_fissare, ai_attiva=false, cliente_da_fissare notification created), take/reactivate, operator messages, leads search/patch/status-change with history+notif, home priorities (foto_profilo/ig_username/piattaforma present), analytics with filters + by_campaign, campaigns lead_count, integrations non_attivo, RBAC (operator 403 on services/locations POST). Frontend (mobile 390x844): quick-admin login → priorities landing shows 'DA FISSARE ADESSO' with cards, go-dashboard-button routes to Chat tab, 13 conversation rows visible, opening a conversation renders correctly with RIATTIVA AI/PRENDI toggle logic working, Simula cliente/Simula AI buttons present, bottom tabs Chat/Clienti/Pipeline/Analytics/Altro all load, Pipeline shows DA FISSARE column, Analytics and Clienti screens render, Altro shows sezioni + Esci (logout). All core functionality verified. Only a minor React Native web deprecation console warning noted (props.pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on Chat/Conversation screens. Likely from a Pressable/View using pointerEvents as prop instead of style.pointerEvents in RN Web. Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Migrate any `<View pointerEvents=...>` / `<Pressable pointerEvents=...>` usages to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 965 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, conversations, leads, pipeline, analytics, altro, notifications) for maintainability before Fase 2.

analytics endpoint uses an O(N) awaited query per lead (nested await inside comprehension around messages count) — acceptable for 13 seed leads but must be refactored with aggregation pipeline before real traffic.
Conversations/messages endpoints do not enforce operator/admin scoping beyond authentication — fine for Fase 1 demo but noted for future phases.
No rate limiting / no explicit CORS whitelist (allow_origins=['*']) — expected for Fase 1 demo but should be tightened later.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created; app seeds automatically on startup. Tests use existing 13 seeded leads and their conversations. Test-created data (services/notes) is deleted or prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests/test_supergirl_api.py and uses /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Uses -n 2 loadscope; TestAIQualify picks last ai_attiva conv, TestAIHandoff picks middle one, TestTakeReactivate picks first to avoid races. Handoff test consumes an AI-active conversation (moves lead to da_fissare) — this is idempotent-safe as long as at least one ai_attiva conv remains. If DB is fully seeded this always holds. Frontend testIDs coverage: login-*, quick-admin, quick-operator, go-dashboard-button, priority-card-*, conversation-row-*, take-conversation-button, reactivate-ai-button, sim-customer-button, sim-ai-button, sim-customer-input, sim-send, conv-back, conv-banner, message-input, send-message-button.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found; the initial handoff test failure during the first pytest run was a race condition in my own test (two parallel workers picking conv[0]); fixed by having qualify use last, handoff use middle, take/reactivate use first AI-active conversation.
